name: Fly Plane Button
description: Send button that folds into a paper plane on click, flies off the top, then reveals a success label before resetting. Built from clip-path polygons animated with GSAP CSS variables.
contents: Success label revealed after the plane takes off
behavior: Click folds the button into a paper plane and flies it up and out
Success label scales in, then the button fades back after 2 seconds
Clicks are ignored while the animation runs
GSAP is dynamic-imported on first click
editableByProps: Button, fold shade, text and success colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Click handler such as submitting a form

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
